name: Just Dial Ltd
about: Justdial is the market leader in local search engine segment in India. The Company provides local search-related services to users across India in a platform-agnostic manner. The multi-platform offering includes App (Android, iOS), mobile website, desktop /PC, voice and text. [1]
keyPoints:
Pan-India Presence[1]
The company has ~12000 employees in telesales, marketing, feet-on-street activities deployed across 250+ cities covering 11,000+ pincodes in India. It derives 70% of its revenues from top 11 cities including Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, etc. Its technology and R&D division is located in Bengaluru.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.86% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.387 Cr.
